caption:
Mortgage rates dipped again. Still not cheap. 🏠

Freddie Mac says the average 30-year fixed rate was 7.24% on Oct 29, down from 7.32% the week before.
A year ago it was 6.17%.

Smaller drop, same tough math for buyers.
Are you waiting to buy, or have you given up on the idea?
first_comment: If you're house hunting, what monthly payment is your hard limit? 👇
